profile_text.body:
Zebra Technologies Corp. describes itself as powering intelligent operations, saying it helps organizations digitize, automate and enhance processes with mobile computers, scanners, printers, RFID and more. The company markets manufacturing technology solutions that combine hardware and software for automation, data analysis and factory connectivity, and it says its automation solutions are built for flexibility, simplicity and value in addressing operational challenges.

On the AI side, Zebra points to Zebra Companion AI, which it says offers instant, tailored insights and support for frontline operations, and to Zebra Frontline AI Enablers, which include AI vision models, sample apps and APIs. It also describes Frontline AI Blueprints as adaptable frameworks that automate manual tasks, and the Zebra Aurora suite of machine vision software as addressing track-and-trace, vision inspection and industrial automation needs. Zebra Aurora Focus is presented as an interface for setting up, deploying and running the company's Fixed Industrial Scanners and Machine Vision Smart Cameras. Zebra says its AI is an intelligent and open platform built to integrate with RFID, enterprise software and machine vision. The site notes that some content or images may have been created with the assistance of AI.

Zebra is a public company headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois, trading under the ticker ZBRA, with a CIK of 0000877212. Its litigation exposure is recorded in Illinois, with a count of 375.
